NOTE
**Still not ready: the PR template isn't filled in, and nothing shows the change was tested**

New: The author rebased (no change to the code or commit) and says the PR addresses #37647, though the PR doesn't link it. Missing: "Fixes: #37647", screenshots and a description of manual testing (the PR says the fix came from "code analysis"), and the self-review checklist. Open PR #39267 also targets the same issue, and #37647's "help wanted" status isn't shown in the input.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; apoorvapendse (who gave the first feedback) should check whether #37647 has "help wanted" and whether #39267 already covers it.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the rebase! Please keep "not ready" for now: add "Fixes: #37647" and fill in the rest of the PR template, including before/after screenshots and how you tested it in the browser (see the [review process guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/review-process.html)). Also note that #39267 is an open PR for the same issue, so please compare with it.
```
